mapper.select: SELECT a.tenant_id,a.project_id,a.artifact_id,m.document_id,m.document_revision,a.artifact_kind FROM artifact a JOIN document_revision_meta m ON m.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND m.project_id=a.project_id AND m.document_revision=a.document_revision JOIN artifact_content_binding b ON b.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND b.project_id=a.project_id AND b.artifact_id=a.artifact_id AND b.resource_kind='DOCUMENT' AND b.resource_id=m.document_id WHERE a.artifact_id=#{artifactId} AND (a.artifact_kind IN ('DOCUMENT_FIELDS','DOCUMENT_EVIDENCE') OR (a.artifact_kind='DOCUMENT_BODY' AND m.body_artifact_id=a.artifact_id)) FOR UPDATE

SELECT d.tenant_id,d.project_id,d.document_id,m.document_revision,d.current_document_revision,d.revision,d.status,p.status AS project_status, m.task_id,m.task_revision,m.snapshot_id,t.profile_revision,m.body_artifact_id,m.body_sha256,r.body_object_key, m.body_object_version,m.body_schema_revision,m.plan_revision,m.template_version,m.dependency_access_set_id, m.issue_watermark,m.content_sha256,m.created_by,m.created_at,m.classification FROM document_head d JOIN document_revision_meta m ON m.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND m.project_id=d.project_id AND m.document_id=d.document_id JOIN project p ON p.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND p.project_id=d.project_id JOIN document_revision r ON r.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND r.project_id=m.project_id AND r.document_revision=m.document_revision JOIN task_revision t ON t.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND t.project_id=m.project_id AND t.task_id=m.task_id AND t.task_revision=m.task_revision WHERE d.document_id=#{documentId} AND d.project_id=#{projectId} AND m.document_revision=#{documentRevision} AND m.document_revision=d.current_document_revision FOR UPDATE

SELECT artifact_id,artifact_kind FROM artifact a WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND document_revision=#{documentRevision} AND artifact_kind IN ('DOCUMENT_FIELDS','DOCUMENT_EVIDENCE') ORDER BY artifact_kind,artifact_id FOR UPDATE
SELECT issue_watermark,evidence_watermark FROM document_revision_state s WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND document_revision=#{documentRevision} FOR UPDATE
SELECT check_id FROM check_run c WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND target_kind='DOCUMENT' AND target_id=#{documentId} AND target_revision=#{documentRevision} ORDER BY check_id FOR UPDATE
SELECT review_id FROM review_decision r WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND document_revision=#{documentRevision} ORDER BY review_id FOR UPDATE
SELECT signature_id FROM signature_record s WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND document_id=#{documentId} AND document_revision=#{documentRevision} ORDER BY signature_id FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.stream_id,s.owner_resource_id,CAST(s.last_sequence AS CHAR) AS sequence FROM stream_registry s WHERE s.project_id=#{projectId} AND s.kind='RUN' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stream_event e WHERE e.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND e.stream_id=s.stream_id AND e.resource_kind='DOCUMENT' AND e.resource_id=#{documentId}) ORDER BY s.stream_id FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scope_member m WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND snapshot_id=#{snapshotId}

SELECT d.tenant_id,d.project_id,d.document_id,m.document_revision,d.current_document_revision,d.revision,d.status,p.status AS project_status, m.task_id,m.task_revision,m.snapshot_id,t.profile_revision,m.body_artifact_id,m.body_sha256,r.body_object_key, m.body_object_version,m.body_schema_revision,m.plan_revision,m.template_version,m.dependency_access_set_id, m.issue_watermark,m.content_sha256,m.created_by,m.created_at,m.classification FROM document_head d JOIN document_revision_meta m ON m.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND m.project_id=d.project_id AND m.document_id=d.document_id JOIN project p ON p.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND p.project_id=d.project_id JOIN document_revision r ON r.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND r.project_id=m.project_id AND r.document_revision=m.document_revision JOIN task_revision t ON t.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND t.project_id=m.project_id AND t.task_id=m.task_id AND t.task_revision=m.task_revision WHERE d.document_id=#{documentId} AND d.project_id=#{projectId} AND m.document_revision=#{documentRevision} AND m.document_revision=d.current_document_revision LIMIT 2 FOR UPDATE

SELECT artifact_id,artifact_kind FROM artifact a WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND document_revision=#{documentRevision} AND artifact_kind IN ('DOCUMENT_FIELDS','DOCUMENT_EVIDENCE') ORDER BY artifact_kind,artifact_id LIMIT 3 FOR UPDATE
SELECT issue_watermark,evidence_watermark FROM document_revision_state s WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND document_revision=#{documentRevision} LIMIT 2 FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.tenant_id,s.project_id,s.snapshot_id,CASE WHEN OCTET_LENGTH(s.manifest) <= #{maximumMetadataBytes} THEN s.manifest ELSE NULL END AS manifest,s.manifest_sha256,s.auth_epoch,s.governance_epoch,s.created_at, v.content_sha256 AS registry_hash FROM scope_snapshot s LEFT JOIN version_registry v ON v.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND v.version_id=s.snapshot_id AND v.owner_project_id=s.project_id WHERE s.project_id=#{projectId} AND s.snapshot_id=#{snapshotId} LIMIT 2
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT m.source_version FROM scope_member m WHERE m.project_id=#{projectId} AND m.snapshot_id=#{snapshotId} LIMIT #{metadataLimit}) bounded_members
SELECT OCTET_LENGTH(s.manifest) FROM scope_snapshot s WHERE s.project_id=#{projectId} AND s.snapshot_id=#{snapshotId} LIMIT 2
